evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth: 3.00 -> 3.073 -> 3.136 -> 3.189 -> 3.227 Torr, far above the ~0.01-0.02 Torr scatter seen in purge/ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm on setpoint, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple stable at 750 °C with heater power ~44%, consistent with normal thermal control
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak state cannot be verified, so seal leak vs exhaust blockage cannot be separated

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 (or RGA/leak-check) reading would distinguish air ingress from a restriction; absent that, a flow-step test (e.g., step Ar 100->50 sccm) would discriminate: blockage gives pressure roughly proportional to flow, a leak leaves a flow-independent pressure offset.
